messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1010 we have a partner co-branded launch next week. Need a small asset pack for the benchmark release: 3 tiles (latency, cost, throughput) with co-brand-safe variants, a webinar hero slide, a 1-slide sales summary, and email headers (2 widths). Deadline: Thurs noon so sales can prep. Who can own export+naming?

Elliott: I can own design + exports. question: partner requires us to use their logo lockup on some slides. Do we have their brand guidelines?

Maya: yes, partner sent guidelines and two logos. they want a muted palette variant and a version that stacks logos vertically. i'll upload assets to drive.

DesignBot: figma file created: https://redwood.app/figma/partner-launch-1789004567 (components: bench-tile, hero-16x9, email-headers). Export presets: PNG@2x, SVG, PPTX template.

Kai: localization scope? i can cover EN/FR/DE/ES/JP. prefer separate CSV with copy keys + context + alt-text. also confirm character limits for email headers.

Maya: good call. email headers: 600x200 and 1200x300. keep headline under 40 chars for mobile. CSV link: https://files.redwood/partner_copy_1789.csv. include alt-text column.

Elliott: export naming proposal (please review):

bench_latency_EN_v1.svg
bench_latency_EN_v1_co-brand.svg
hero_EN_v1_1920x1080.png
hero_EN_v1_co-brand_1920x1080.png
email_header_EN_600x200_v1.png
slide_sales_EN_v1.PPTX

I'll append locale codes for translations. Anything to change?

SalesOps: please include a plain-text one-liner for the sales slide and a shorteditable takeaway on the right. Also add a small placeholder for customer logo and a one-line source attribution under the tiles.

LegalOps: avoid comparative superlatives, e.g., "fastest". Use approx (e) or ranges, and include a data-source footnote. I'll need final copy 48h before external publish.

Elliott: noted. i'll include a footnote field under tiles and a muted-color mask for partner decks. Also adding a grayscale fallback for print.

DesignBot: added token set: brand-muted, brand-default, grayscale. Contrast checks will run during export and warnings will appear as figma comments.

Kai: i'll prepare translations once i get the keyed CSV. timeline: localized strings back Wed evening. small ask: do we want localized number formats (commas vs periods)?

Maya: yes, localize number formatting for FR/DE and JP. add small parenthetical units (ms / $ per 1M tokens).

Elliott: uploading first drafts Tue afternoon. export checklist (to include with assets):

- file manifest (CSV)
- readme.txt (one-liners & CTA options)
- license/partner-logo usage note
- pptx master slides + editable text fields

Export command snippet (internal):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood/figma/export -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIGMA_TOKEN" -d '{"file":"partner-launch-1789004567","formats":["svg","png@2x","pptx"]}'

Will attach manifest to the figma file.

SalesOps: can we get two headline CTAs to A/B — "Register" and "See the numbers"? i'll coordinate the test.

Maya: yes please include both CTAs in the slide variants. final approvals: Maya for marketing, LegalOps for copy, Partner for co-brand usage. thanks team 64f ping if anything blocks.
